description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ChargeMustBePenaltyException' for the Apache Fineract project. It extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' and is used to signal errors related to incorrect charge types, specifically when a charge that is required to be a penalty is not correctly designated.

classes.name: ChargeMustBePenaltyException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the Fineract platform to indicate that a charge must be a penalty but isn't correctly classified.

methods.name: ChargeMustBePenaltyException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an instance of the exception with a specific charge name indicating the invalid charge type.
